enchantment.overenchanted.blazing_edge.d: Grants a chance to ignite nearby enemies on hit.
enchantment.overenchanted.blazing_walker: Enables you to walk safely on lava.
enchantment.overenchanted.breaking_curse: Causes the item to break faster with use.
enchantment.overenchanted.explosive_shot: Creates a small explosion when hitting a mob.
enchantment.overenchanted.enraged.desc: Increases attack damage by +30% and reduces armor by -20% per level.
enchantment.overenchanted.floating.desc: Causes the enemy to float for a short period of time.
enchantment.overenchanted.free_riding.de: Prevents durability from decreasing while boosting speed on a pig or strider.
enchantment.overenchanted.ignorance_curs: Mobs and mined blocks will not drop experience.
enchantment.overenchanted.paralysis.desc: Applies paralysis to a mob, preventing it from moving, jumping, or attacking for a short period of time.
enchantment.overenchanted.reinforced_tip: Increases the speed of breaking harder materials.
enchantment.overenchanted.fleetfoot.desc: Increases movement speed by +15% but reduces knockback resistance by -20% per level.
enchantment.overenchanted.aqua_glide.des: Boosts swim speed and grants the dolphin effect when hurt.
enchantment.overenchanted.aqua_miner.des: Increases mining speed while submerged in water.
enchantment.overenchanted.lifebinder.des: Attacking an enemy has a chance to heal your pets within a 5-block radius.
enchantment.overenchanted.stun.desc: Attacking when falling from over 2 blocks stuns the enemy (excluding bosses).
enchantment.overenchanted.echo_sight.des: Reveals hidden targets. Check keybindings to activate.
enchantment.overenchanted.lumberjack.des: Hold the Lumberjack Key to chop down entire trees at once.
